email.subject: Quick fix for Dockside Plumbing's site
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Dockside Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial manually, and your hours aren't listed anywhere, so people searching after-hours don't know if you're open and go to a competitor instead.

The site's also slow to load on phones because of heavy, uncompressed images, and the footer still shows an old copyright year, which makes it look unmaintained.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
